import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (scanner.hasNext()) {
            String inputStr = scanner.next();
            int len = inputStr.length();
            StringBuilder transformed = new StringBuilder();
            transformed.append(inputStr.charAt(0));
            int pos = 1;
            int checkFlag = 0;
            while (pos < len) {
                if (checkFlag == 0 && pos < len - 1) {
                    String twoChars = inputStr.substring(pos, pos + 2);
                    if (twoChars.equals("at")) {
                        transformed.append('@');
                        pos += 2;
                        checkFlag++;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if (pos + 2 < len) {
                    String threeChars = inputStr.substring(pos, pos + 3);
                    if (threeChars.equals("dot")) {
                        transformed.append('.');
                        pos += 3;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                transformed.append(inputStr.charAt(pos));
                pos++;
            }
            System.out.print(transformed.toString());
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
